create_mobile_manipulator: create a MobileManipulator instance with params, agent config, and simulator for a controllable robot base and arm
configure_mobile_manipulator_params: configure MobileManipulatorParams to set arm joints, gripper joints, end-effector offsets, and camera placements for a mobile robot
reconfigure_mobile_manipulator: reconfigure a MobileManipulator to reload the URDF and reset initial state of parameters, joints, and motors
update_mobile_manipulator: update a MobileManipulator to refresh camera transformations and check joint limits and sleep states
reset_mobile_manipulator: reset a MobileManipulator to restore arm and gripper joint motors to their initial positions
